notices.short_title: Extension of Public Comment Period and Second Public Hearing on Proposed Rules Regarding Donations and Gifts to the City
notices.plain: The Conflicts of Interest Board has extended its public comment period and scheduled a second public hearing on proposed rules about donations and gifts to the City, to be held June 23, 2026.

The Office of Administrative Trials and Hearings awarded American Computer Consultants Inc a $98,328 contract for Dell Pro Slim Plus QBS1250 computer equipment through a small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business, made without competition.

notices.short_title: SERVICE AGREEMENT FOR CHILLER RENTAL SERVICES
notices.plain: The Office of Chief Medical Examiner awarded United Rentals North America, Inc. a $59,178 contract for chiller rental services, bought through a contract another government already holds.
The Department of Citywide Administrative Services is seeking bids for elevator monitoring services, with the lowest qualified bidder to win, and responses are due June 16, 2026.

notices.vendor_name: City Sounds of New York - Speech Language Development Center Inc
notices.plain: The Department of Education renewed a $25,000 contract with City Sounds of New York - Speech Language Development Center Inc for assessments for special education.

notices.short_title: 05726B0007-HAZMAT METER INSPECTION, PREVENTATIVE MAINTENANCE, REPAIR, PARTS, CALIBRATION, TRAINING AND REPLACEMENT
notices.plain: The Fire Department is seeking bids, due May 18, 2026, from vendors to inspect, maintain, repair, calibrate and train staff on hazardous materials meters, and to supply parts and replacements, with the lowest qualified bid to win.

notices.short_title: CNYG-2323MAR-Mechanical, electrical and plumbing (MEP) engineering consulting services for various Parks projects, Citywide
notices.plain: The Department of Parks and Recreation has renewed a contract with IMEG Consultants Corp for mechanical, electrical and plumbing engineering consulting services on various Parks projects citywide, worth $9 million.

notices.short_title: CNYG-1323MAR Civil Structural Engineering consulting services for various Parks projects, Citywide
notices.plain: The Department of Parks and Recreation has renewed its contract with IMEG Consultants Corp for civil structural engineering consulting services on various Parks projects citywide, valued at $9 million.

notices.short_title: Commercial Waste Zone Midtown North and Manhattan Southwest Implementation
notices.plain: The Department of Sanitation is seeking proposals from vendors for commercial waste zone implementation in Midtown North and Manhattan Southwest, with responses due June 10, 2026.
The Teachers' Retirement System is seeking bids for Gartner advisory services through a negotiated acquisition, with responses due April 24, 2026.

notices.short_title: Secure Detention Surveillance System Installation and Maint.
notices.plain: The Administration for Children's Services published a notice on April 22, 2026, about a public comment period on a contract for installing and maintaining a secure detention surveillance system.
The Department of Transportation published a notice on Apr. 22, 2026, about janitorial services for its facilities, and the notice invites public comment on contract awards.

The Department of Youth and Community Development published a notice on April 22, 2026, about the FY27 NAE Cornerstone Community Center, a public comment item on contract awards that gives no vendor, amount or deadline.
The Department of Youth and Community Development published a notice on April 22, 2026, about a reissued FY27 NAE Cornerstone solicitation, which is listed only by that title.
The Department of Youth and Community Development published a notice about public comment on contract awards for immigrant family services, without naming a vendor, amount or deadline.
The Department of Youth and Community Development posted a notice on April 22, 2026, about a Summer Youth Employment Program contract award, but the notice's title is all it gives.

The notice only gives a title, so I restate it plainly: The Department of Youth and Community Development posted a public comment notice on April 22, 2026, about contract awards under the FY27 NAE COMPASS Horizon program.
The Community Boards agency will hold a public hearing on April 28, 2026, according to the notice published April 22, 2026.
The Equal Employment Practices Commission will hold its Commission Meeting #287 on April 30, 2026.
The Landmarks Preservation Commission has posted an agenda for a public hearing on May 5, 2026, though the notice title gives the year as 2025.
